india.one_line: Indian businesses scale up AI production while Nasscom warns that automation threatens entry-level tech jobs.

themes.title: Enterprises scale up AI production
themes.text: Indian businesses have shifted from AI pilot tests to full-scale enterprise production over the past year and a half, despite challenges with cost and skills.

stories.headline: Oracle India says firms are moving from AI pilots to full-scale production

themes.title: AI threatens entry-level tech jobs
themes.text: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warned that AI coding automation could impact graduate jobs, urging a computer science curriculum overhaul.

stories.headline: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warns AI may impact tech jobs for graduates
